headline: Nigerian equities market declines as major stocks face selling pressure
summary: The Nigerian Exchange (NGX) lost N540 billion in market capitalization on Friday. Sustained selling in major stocks including MTN Nigeria, Zenith Bank, and GTCO drove the decline.
why: The NGX is the primary stock exchange in Nigeria, and the performance of these large-cap companies is a key indicator of investor sentiment in the Nigerian economy.
why_moved: The decline is attributed to sustained selling pressure on major blue-chip stocks, which carry significant weight in the Nigerian equity market index.
